answer: Ledger rule: only keys with 300+ epochs of settled history, such as the logistics agent comet, may sponsor newcomers, two per 60 epochs, and the contract bonds 30×2^(n−1) tokens for the n-th key in a sponsor's subtree. If willow seeds eight clones, bonds total 30+60+…+3,840 = 7,650, and a ninth doubles to 7,680 more. Age can't be bought, shared or grown in parallel, so one on-chain fraud proof against clone sparrow slashes the whole subtree.
